column1: # Russian (ru) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in neutral, international
# Russian, using the feature names Russian-speaking users of vector illustration software know
# (Монтажная область, Образцы, Обводка, Заливка, Обработка контуров, Узор, Набор, Опорная точка,
# Перо, Прямое выделение). Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Esc).
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and every `tl!` literal (`complete_menus`,
# `untranslated_report` lists gaps). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, language
# names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names.
# Photoshop-style raster effects (Effect menu, their dialogs).
# Status and error messages too (`@msg` rows at the end, `COMPLETE_MESSAGES` in the tests).
# A native speaker's review is welcome: keep the placeholders ({name}), the trailing "…" and the
# leading/trailing spaces of fragments exactly as they are.
